crossRefs.note: Yet have respect for the prayer of your servant, and for his supplication, Yahweh my God, to listen to the cry and to…
Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.
Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
“Now therefore, our God, listen to the prayer of your servant, and to his petitions, and cause your face to shine on…
He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray, and not give up,
Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.
Give ear to my words, Yahweh. Consider my meditation.
Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God; for I pray to you.
May Yahweh answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,
Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,

translations.web: Yet have respect for the prayer of your servant, and to his supplication, Yahweh my God, to listen to the cry and to the prayer which your servant prays before you;
translations.bsb: Yet regard the prayer and plea of Your servant, O LORD my God, so that You may hear the cry and the prayer that Your servant is praying before You.
translations.kjv: Have respect therefore to the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee:
translations.asv: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O Jehovah my God, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee;
